chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 31 – The Skygreen Serpent King Awakens: Ji Ning’s First Xiantian Kill
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces the monstrous Water Rhinoceros King in life-or-death combat. After a tactical loss, he unleashes his Fiendgod power and claims his first Xiantian kill. But the Skygreen Serpent King answers the call.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 31 – Ji Ning Claims His First Great Demon
og_description: A brutal Xianxia boss fight: Ji Ning transitions from tactical Ki Refiner to primal Fiendgod, claiming his first Xiantian kill. The chapter ends with a chilling whirlpool—the Skygreen Serpent King has arrived.
twitter_title: The Water Rhinoceros King is dead, but the Serpent King is awake!
twitter_description: Ji Ning masters ‘Moth to the Flame’ in a desperate final strike. He gets the loot, but a new, far scarier monster is on the way.
